name: Telegram
description: Bounded typed Telegram Bot API messaging, media metadata, polls, bot settings, members, invites and forum topics.

permissions.description: One fixed HTTPS Telegram Bot API request with external bot token. Send/write actions require explicit confirmation and may notify users; paid broadcasts require separate charge confirmation. No local files, arbitrary downloads, listeners, polling, account login or token refresh. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Telegram Get Me (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Get Me
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getMe. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getme

definitions.description: Telegram Get Chat
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getChat. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getchat

definitions.description: Telegram Get Chat Member
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getChatMember. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getchatmember

definitions.description: Telegram Get Chat Administrators
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getChatAdministrators. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getchatadministrators

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getChatMemberCount. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getchatmembercount

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getUserProfilePhotos. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getuserprofilephotos

definitions.description: Telegram Get File
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getFile. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getfile

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Get Webhook Info
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getWebhookInfo. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getwebhookinfo

definitions.name: Telegram Send Message (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Telegram Send Photo (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Photo
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendPhoto. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendPhoto". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendphoto

definitions.name: Telegram Send Document (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Document
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendDocument. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendDocument". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#senddocument

definitions.description: Telegram Send Audio
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendAudio. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendAudio". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendaudio

definitions.name: Telegram Send Video (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Video
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendVideo. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendVideo". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideo

definitions.name: Telegram Send Animation (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Animation
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendAnimation. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendAnimation". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendanimation

definitions.name: Telegram Send Voice (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Voice
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendVoice. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendVoice". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvoice

definitions.name: Telegram Send Media Group (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Media Group
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendMediaGroup. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendMediaGroup". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmediagroup

definitions.name: Telegram Forward Message (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Forward Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API forwardMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM forwardMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#forwardmessage

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Telegram Copy Message (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Copy Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API copyMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM copyMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#copymessage

definitions.description: Telegram Send Location
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendLocation. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendLocation". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlocation

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Telegram Send Contact (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Contact
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendContact. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendContact". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendcontact

definitions.description: Telegram Send Dice
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendDice. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendDice". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. definitions.name: Telegram Send Chat Action (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Chat Action
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendChatAction. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendChatAction". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendchataction

definitions.name: Telegram Send Poll (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Send Poll
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API sendPoll. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM sendPoll". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendpoll

definitions.name: Telegram Stop Poll (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Stop Poll
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API stopPoll. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM stopPoll". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#stoppoll

definitions.description: Telegram Edit Message Text
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editMessageText. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editMessageText". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editmessagetext

definitions.description: Telegram Edit Message Caption
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editMessageCaption. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editMessageCaption". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editmessagecaption

definitions.description: Telegram Edit Message Media
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editMessageMedia. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editMessageMedia". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editmessagemedia

definitions.description: Telegram Edit Message Reply Markup
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editMessageReplyMarkup. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editMessageReplyMarkup". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editmessagereplymarkup

definitions.description: Telegram Delete Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletemessage

definitions.description: Telegram Delete Messages
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteMessages. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteMessages". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletemessages

definitions.name: Telegram Pin Chat Message (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Pin Chat Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API pinChatMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM pinChatMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#pinchatmessage

definitions.description: Telegram Unpin Chat Message
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unpinChatMessage. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unpinChatMessage". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unpinchatmessage

definitions.description: Telegram Unpin All Chat Messages
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unpinAllChatMessages. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unpinAllChatMessages". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unpinallchatmessages

definitions.name: Telegram Answer Callback Query (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Answer Callback Query
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API answerCallbackQuery. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM answerCallbackQuery". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answercallbackquery

definitions.name: Telegram Answer Inline Query (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Answer Inline Query
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API answerInlineQuery. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM answerInlineQuery". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answerinlinequery

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Telegram Get My Commands (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Get My Commands
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getMyCommands. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getmycommands

definitions.name: Telegram Set My Commands (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Set My Commands
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setMyCommands. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setMyCommands". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setmycommands

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Delete My Commands
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteMyCommands. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteMyCommands". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletemycommands

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Get My Name
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getMyName. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getmyname

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Set My Description
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setMyDescription. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setMyDescription". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setmydescription

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Get My Short Description
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getMyShortDescription. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getmyshortdescription

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setMyShortDescription. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setMyShortDescription". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setmyshortdescription

Official Bot API setChatMenuButton. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatMenuButton". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatmenubutton

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API getMyDefaultAdministratorRights. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. definitions.description: Telegram Set Chat Title
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setChatTitle. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatTitle". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchattitle

definitions.description: Telegram Set Chat Description
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setChatDescription. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatDescription". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatdescription

definitions.description: Telegram Set Chat Permissions
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setChatPermissions. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatPermissions". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatpermissions

definitions.description: Telegram Delete Chat Photo
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteChatPhoto. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteChatPhoto". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletechatphoto

definitions.name: Telegram Leave Chat (Direct)
definitions.description: Telegram Leave Chat
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API leaveChat. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM leaveChat". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#leavechat

definitions.description: Telegram Set Chat Sticker Set
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setChatStickerSet. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatStickerSet". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatstickerset

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteChatStickerSet. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteChatStickerSet". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletechatstickerset

definitions.description: Telegram Ban Chat Member
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API banChatMember. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM banChatMember". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#banchatmember

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unbanChatMember. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unbanChatMember". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unbanchatmember

definitions.description: Telegram Restrict Chat Member
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API restrictChatMember. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM restrictChatMember". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#restrictchatmember

definitions.description: Telegram Promote Chat Member
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API promoteChatMember. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM promoteChatMember". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#promotechatmember

definitions.description: Telegram Set Chat Administrator Custom Title
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API setChatAdministratorCustomTitle. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM setChatAdministratorCustomTitle". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatadministratorcustomtitle

definitions.description: Telegram Ban Chat Sender Chat
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API banChatSenderChat. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM banChatSenderChat". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#banchatsenderchat
