definitions.description: Telegram Unban Chat Sender Chat
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unbanChatSenderChat. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unbanChatSenderChat". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unbanchatsenderchat

definitions.description: Telegram Export Chat Invite Link
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API exportChatInviteLink. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM exportChatInviteLink". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#exportchatinvitelink

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API createChatInviteLink. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM createChatInviteLink". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createchatinvitelink

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editChatInviteLink. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editChatInviteLink". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editchatinvitelink

definitions.description: Telegram Revoke Chat Invite Link
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API revokeChatInviteLink. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM revokeChatInviteLink". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#revokechatinvitelink

definitions.description: Telegram Approve Chat Join Request
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API approveChatJoinRequest. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM approveChatJoinRequest". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#approvechatjoinrequest

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Telegram Decline Chat Join Request
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API declineChatJoinRequest. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM declineChatJoinRequest". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#declinechatjoinrequest

definitions.description: Telegram Create Forum Topic
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API createForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM createForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#createforumtopic

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editforumtopic

definitions.description: Telegram Close Forum Topic
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API closeForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM closeForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#closeforumtopic

definitions.description: Telegram Reopen Forum Topic
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API reopenForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM reopenForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#reopenforumtopic

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API deleteForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM deleteForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deleteforumtopic

Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unpinallforumtopicmessages

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API editGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM editGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editgeneralforumtopic

definitions.description: Telegram Close General Forum Topic
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API closeGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM closeGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#closegeneralforumtopic

definitions.description: Telegram Reopen General Forum Topic
definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API reopenGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM reopenGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#reopengeneralforumtopic

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API hideGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM hideGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#hidegeneralforumtopic

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unhideGeneralForumTopic. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unhideGeneralForumTopic". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unhidegeneralforumtopic

definitions.documentation:
Official Bot API unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages. One POST to fixed api.telegram.org; the secret-bearing transport URL is never returned. Exact RuntimeConnection.config/credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback), or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / tokenSecret. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="TELEGRAM unpinAllGeneralForumTopicMessages". $retries must be numeric zero; no retry, automatic pagination, listeners, webhook registration or downloads. Sends, forwards, copies, callbacks and other changes can notify users. allow_paid_broadcast=true additionally requires confirmPaidBroadcast=true and may charge Telegram Stars. File references are existing file IDs or explicit HTTPS URL metadata that Telegram may fetch; this node never fetches those URLs or forwards its credential to them. Chat/user int64 IDs use canonical exact decimal text and are emitted as exact JSON numeric tokens, including IDs above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Known result fields are projected, unknown fields omitted; metadata is untrusted. Strict UTF8/UTF16, 512KiB request, 1MiB response, depth35, 100000 values, 16384 nonempty fragments, whole deadline100–30000ms starts before credentials and guards final cleanup. Failures are bounded/redacted and delivery can be uncertain. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#unpinallgeneralforumtopicmessages

definitions.name: Telegram Message Received Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Telegram Message Received.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Telegram Message Received. Direct webhook: setWebhook secret_token sends X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token; configure that exact ingress header and saved secret. The trigger reads context.input only, projects minimized typed fields, and performs exact optional chatId/senderId filtering. It does not acknowledge callback queries through the Telegram API; use a separate explicit Answer Callback Query operation when needed. Other update kinds skip. The last 100 update IDs deduplicate per group; checkpoint commits before downstream completion. IDs are exact decimal strings projected from safe integer Telegram IDs; unsafe values reject. Text/caption may be null for media-only messages. Source: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api

ingressRequirements.name: Telegram bot updates
ingressRequirements.description: Direct HTTPS callbacks protected by Telegram setWebhook secret_token in X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; installation does not provision any event delivery.
Publish the existing ONF HTTP listener through a reviewed HTTPS proxy preserving raw JSON bytes and required authentication headers.
Save the callback secret in Infrastructure → Secrets; create an ingress profile for this package requirement using header token in X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token.
Bind the intended trigger node to that profile, save its provider filters, and deliberately enable both workflow and entry.
Choose a new 1–256 character secret_token allowed by Telegram (A–Z, a–z, 0–9, underscore and hyphen); save it encrypted.
Configure the ingress profile header name exactly X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token with that saved secret reference.

Explicitly call Telegram setWebhook outside package installation with the displayed HTTPS callback URL, matching secret_token and only intended allowed_updates. Telegram permits one webhook per bot; review existing registration before replacing it.
Do not enable getUpdates for the same bot while webhook delivery is active; webhook setup and any pending-update handling are separate authorized operations.
Authorize a synthetic provider delivery and inspect its accepted run; HTTP 202 proves admission only. Review provider retries and downstream idempotency.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/bot-updates"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
